title: Depreciation of Stolen Items by Age: HostCover Valuation Guideline
content:
Stolen items are paid at an age-depreciated value on some levels of **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)**. The theft depreciation share follows the plan level and the age in whole months the claim records for the stolen items. On a level whose items are paid at depreciated value, items 61 months old or older are depreciated by 60 percent, items 37 to 60 months old by 40 percent and items 13 to 36 months old by 20 percent; items 12 months old or younger, and items on a level whose items are not paid at depreciated value, are not depreciated. The depreciation reduces the verified theft loss itself: the percentage is taken off the loss the claims team verified, and the guest payments and the deductible are subtracted from the depreciated theft loss.

## Levels that pay stolen items at depreciated value

| HostCover level | Depreciated value |
|---|---|
| HostCover Essential | Yes |
| HostCover Standard | Yes |
| HostCover Plus | Yes |
| HostCover Premier | Yes |
| HostCover Elite | No |
| HostCover Estate | No |

## Theft depreciation by age (levels marked Yes above)

| Item age the claim records | Percent taken off the verified theft loss |
|---|---|
| 12 months or younger | none |
| 13 to 36 months | 20 |
| 37 to 60 months | 40 |
| 61 months or older | 60 |

## Either side of each boundary

| Item age | Depreciation |
|---|---|
| 12 months | none |
| 13 months | 20 percent |
| 36 months | 20 percent |
| 37 months | 40 percent |
| 60 months | 40 percent |
| 61 months | 60 percent |

## Examples (hypothetical claims)

- A verified theft loss of 1000.00 for a laptop recorded as 40 months old on a HostCover Plus plan is depreciated by 40 percent, to 600.00.
- The same loss on a HostCover Elite plan is not depreciated: 1000.00.
- A verified theft loss of 1000.00 for items recorded as 9 months old on a HostCover Essential plan is not depreciated: 1000.00.
